<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.045 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass most closely is C₄H₈O₄ (monoisotopic mass 120.0423 Da). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
